name: Shokushu Shushusshu! Shusshu!
original_name: 触手しゅしゅっしゅ！しゅっしゅ！
source: The protagonist was suddenly turned into an octopus! To his surprise, a busty but hardworking girl and a flat-chested tsundere want to have sex with him! This sets the stage for a unique pure tentacle love comedy!!
translation: 主角突然变成了章鱼！让他没想到的是，一个巨乳却很努力的女孩和一个平胸傲娇想要和他发生关系！这就为一场独特的纯触手爱情喜剧奠定了基础！！
